_about: Reference set of typical Roblox UI strings from a made-up pet-hatching simulator called 'Pet Hatch Tycoon'. Every locale guide translates this set as worked examples. Keys are stable; do not rename.

game.title: Pet Hatch Tycoon
game.genre: simulator / tycoon: hatch pets from eggs, earn coins, rebirth for a permanent multiplier, trade pets with other players

side HUD; resets coins and pets for a permanent multiplier

params.pet: an already translated pet name like Dragon or Bunny
